metadata.description: Pre-flight checks for coding agents: leaked secrets, blast radius, costs, runaway processes, cheating tests. Offline, zero dependencies.

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: All 17 skills below in one install

plugins.name: trace-scrub
plugins.description: Find API keys and tokens that leaked into your agent session logs, and redact them in place

plugins.name: ai-key-map
plugins.description: Map every copy of your AI provider keys on this machine, with a rotation checklist

plugins.name: blastmap
plugins.description: Before a risky or unattended run: what could an agent started from this shell delete or publish?

plugins.name: mod-audit
plugins.description: See what a Claude Code plugin can do (hooks, network, processes) before you install or upgrade it

plugins.name: cloak-diff
plugins.description: Find text on a web page that people can't see but agents will read (hidden prompt injection)

plugins.name: egress-lock
plugins.description: Run an agent, local model or install script with outbound network limited to an allowlist; every attempt logged

plugins.name: agent-trail
plugins.description: Review what your agent sent out: form posts, pushes, publishes, messages; flag sensitive sites

plugins.name: cost-cliff
plugins.description: Replay your Claude Code / Codex sessions on other models' prices, including long-prompt price tiers

plugins.name: token-blame
plugins.description: Who spent your Claude Code tokens: main thread vs each subagent, cache rebuilds and why

plugins.name: nightcap
plugins.description: Hard dollar cap, pinned tiers and a morning report for agents you leave running overnight

plugins.name: agent-ps
plugins.description: ps + du for coding agents: running sessions, runaway test loops, old versions eating disk

plugins.name: fail-first
plugins.description: Prove a new regression test fails without your fix and passes with it

plugins.name: cheat-drill
plugins.description: Score your Claude Code hooks against 39 known agent cheat moves (editing tests, --no-verify, ...)

plugins.name: port-diff
plugins.description: Behavior-equivalence check for agent-driven ports and rewrites: old vs new on the same inputs

plugins.name: readme-walk
plugins.description: Follow a README literally in a clean copy and write a friction log with concrete fixes

plugins.name: toolcall-smoke
plugins.description: 20-case tool-calling smoke test for local models behind any OpenAI-compatible server

plugins.name: model-census
plugins.description: Which AI models does this codebase use, and whose weights are they built on?
